views.label: Hero
views.note: Thirteen glyphs, g to 8 and back, each change rippling out from the centre: an 8 second loop.

views.label: A change
views.note: g turning into Ж: the centre has sprung out while the edges are still grid dots.

views.label: Detail, 2.5×
views.note: The bowl of the g: each oval sized by the ink in its cell and turned along the stroke.

views.label: Detail, 3.5×
views.note: Where the bowl meets the stem: ovals turning through the join.

views.label: Sweep
views.note: Each change runs left to right instead of from the centre.

views.label: All at once
views.note: Every oval changes at the same moment.

views.label: Flip
views.note: Ovals flip over like coins, edge on halfway, instead of growing from their dots.

views.label: Turn
views.note: Ovals turn and resize in place, never passing through the dot.

views.label: Regular
views.note: Geist Regular instead of Extrabold: thinner strokes, so fewer, smaller ovals.

views.label: Pure blue
views.note: The ground at pure display blue instead of the slightly green one.

views.label: Glyphs 14 to 26
views.note: The next thirteen, Ω to ❸.
